headline: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
angle: A company hemorrhages money on AI, then builds an AI tool to track how much money employees are hemorrhaging on AI.
scene: An office worker sits at a desk staring at a dashboard screen labeled 'AI Spend Console.' The screen displays a red upward-trending graph. Behind the worker, through the glass wall, we see executives in a conference room also staring at identical screens with the same red graphs. Everyone looks equally concerned.
setup: Our new AI spending tracker just identified the problem.
instagram_caption: The solution identified itself as the problem. Full circle.
